records.generatedCopy: Copilot CLI can now start in a configured mode and restore sessions left open after a crash or restart. This checklist shows how to recover useful context without silently expanding tool, path, sandbox, or managed-policy authority. It includes a four-state boundary, conservative defaults, and eight restore canaries for production rollouts.

Restoring Copilot CLI context does not prove the resumed process still has the authority you approved. Re-check mode, permissions, sandbox, paths, policy, and pending side effects first.

Sandboxing limits what a command can reach; approval records whether execution was allowed. Neither one can decide whether deleting a file, exposing a secret, or triggering an external side effect is semantically correct.
